questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to get a perfect body at the gym
The history of British television
Why TV dating shows like Love Island are so popular
Treating people, including men, as objects
questions.why: They discuss objectification and ask 'what about the objectification of men?'

questions.q: According to Sam, what problems can objectification lead to?
options: Inequality and discrimination
Poor health and tiredness
Lower TV ratings
More crime
questions.why: Sam says objectification can lead to issues such as inequality and discrimination.

questions.q: What is special about the contestants on Love Island?
options: They are all famous actors
They are mostly older people looking for a new partner
They often wear swimsuits and have perfect bodies
They are only women
questions.why: Sam says the men and women spend a lot of time in swimming costumes and have perfect bodies.

questions.q: According to Dr Peter Lucas, what possible benefit might these perfect male bodies have?
options: More women might watch TV
More men might go to the gym
Men might become more confident
People might spend less money on clothes and more on holidays
questions.why: He says many women might think 'if it means that more men get off to the gym... that's a good thing'.

questions.q: What is Sam's opinion of the people on Love Island as role models?
options: Their behaviour may not be, but their fitness might be
They are perfect role models for young people in every way
They are bad for everyone's health
They are good examples for children
questions.why: Sam isn't sure their behaviour makes them good role models, but their fitness gives us something to aspire to.

questions.q: What danger does Dr Lucas mention?
options: People might hurt themselves by training too hard at the gym
Gyms will become too crowded
People might become obsessed with their looks
Men might stop watching TV
questions.why: He says it may generate narcissism, self-consciousness and 'becoming obsessive about your appearance'.

questions.q: Why does Dr Lucas compare men today with women?
options: Women have always been fitter than men
Women do not care about appearance
Men now watch more TV than women
The same harm has affected women for decades
questions.why: He says it's detrimental to men 'in the same sort of way' it has been for women for decades.

questions.q: Why might trying to get a perfect body make people self-conscious?
options: Because other people laugh at them in the gym
It is very hard to achieve, so they lose confidence
Because they spend far too much money on gym memberships
Because they have no time for friends
questions.why: Neil says it's very hard to get that kind of body, so people can become embarrassed and lose confidence.
